q: Per your school checklist, how do you set up the Seneca for an emergency descent?
a: Throttles closed, props full forward, gear down, 140 MPH
d: Throttles closed, props full aft, gear up, 190 MPH
Throttles closed, props full forward, gear down, 160 MPH
Throttles closed, props full forward, gear up, flaps 40°, 125 MPH
why: School checklist (Emergency Descent): throttles closed, props full forward, mixtures as required, landing gear down, 140 MPH (120 MPH listed for a demo), cowl flaps closed. 140 MPH keeps the extended gear under its 150 MPH limit; 160 MPH would exceed it. The POH itself has no emergency descent procedure.
